verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an integrated ledger, transaction-level ledger visibility, and in-house ops teams performing 'daily reconciliation, settlement'. None of it documents a machine-readable reconciliation artifact that a finance stack can ingest, such as daily settlement files or a reporting API covering interchange, fees, or network adjustments. Ledger visibility and an internally run reconciliation service are adjacent capabilities, not the deliverable this story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I get machine-readable reconciliation artifacts — daily settlement files or report APIs covering interchange, fees, and network adjustments — that my finance stack can consume automatically
